description.value: Western Lodge is a boutique hotel in Kimberley, BC, situated close to the ski hill and a short distance from downtown. The property hosts The Porch, an on-site restaurant and bar located downstairs offering home-cooked meals and cocktails. The hotel also markets itself as a flexible event venue and appears to be run by LPI Hospitality Group.

address.value: 2665 Warren Avenue, Kimberley, British Columbia V1A 1T7, Canada
